TABLE B – CONTROL FUNCTIONS AND BEHAVIOUR
PPC writes P limit to all inverters when BESS reaches charge limit or SOC ≥ 97 %.
Inverters at PF 1.0 by default; Q setpoint available to PPC.
Bus live (BESS or DG forming the grid). PV cannot energise the bus.
Inverters trip on their own V / f protection (anti-islanding).
Inverter comms watchdog 30 s → fallback P limit (vendor setting, TBC).
SCADA raises P2 alarm, values shown with bad quality.
String current vs. array average: warn at −10 %, alarm at −30 %.
Calculated in SCADA from PV energy and WS-01 irradiation.
